definitions.explanation: Something that one hopes for or aspires to; an expectation or aspiration.
The possibility or likelihood of success.

examples.japanese: {望|のぞ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てないでください→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.notes: {望|のぞ}みを{捨|す}てる = to abandon hope

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{望|のぞ}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Her wish is to become a doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{望|のぞ}み⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to live the way your parents want.
examples.notes: {望|のぞ}み{通|どお}り = as one wishes

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{望|のぞ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{叶|かな}った→叶う：05303_kanau⟧。
examples.english: A wish I'd had since childhood finally came true.

examples.japanese: {望|のぞ}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{望|のぞ}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧。
examples.english: The chances of recovery are slim.
examples.notes: {望|のぞ}みが{薄|うす}い = slim hopes/chances

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{望|のぞ}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ゼロ⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The chance of passing isn't zero.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧{望|のぞ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かって→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{戦|たたか}った→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
examples.english: Even knowing there was no chance of winning, they fought to the end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧{望|のぞ}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Although there's little hope of better weather, the match will be held as scheduled.

notes:
USAGE: {望|のぞ}み is the noun form of ⟦{望|のぞ}む→望む：01976_nozomu⟧ (to hope, to desire). It refers to hopes, wishes, and prospects.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {望|のぞ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have hope)
- {望|のぞ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叶|かな}える→叶える：11807_kanaeru⟧ (to fulfill a wish)
- {望|のぞ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ (to abandon hope)
- {望|のぞ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{ある／ない} (there is/isn't hope)
- {望|のぞ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ (hope is slim)
- {望|のぞ}み⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ (as one wishes)

NOTE: のぞみ is also the name of Japan's fastest Shinkansen (bullet train) service, symbolizing 'hope' for fast travel.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧ - wish, request
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧ - hope, wish (more formal)
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧ - dream
